The '''Amaltannan resistance''' was a resistance group that operated during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Kanz Disorders/Legends|Kanz Disorders]], the [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdians]] allied themselves with the resistance to fight against their [[Slavery/Legends|enslavers]], the [[Argazdan Redoubt]].
